reviews.title: Accidental annual subscription
reviews.text: Hi, I was only trying to start the free trial to test the app, and I don’t know how I ended up being charged for an annual subscription. I never intended to purchase the yearly plan. I don't need it. Could you please help me understand what happened and assist me with a refund? I contacted apple but the request was diclined as it went through third party. I would really appreciate your help. Thank you.
reviews.reply:
Hi [Name]!

Thank you for reaching out, and we're sorry to hear about this situation 💜 We understand how upsetting an unexpected annual subscription can be. 
We'd be happy to review your purchase, explain what happened, and see how we can help with your refund request.

Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com with the email associated with your Nebula account, and our team will investigate your case as quickly as possible.

Grateful to share this path with you,
Nebula 🔮
